notes: The signature sheet for applicants who can't come to the district office to sign ABC-211: each signature is witnessed by an ABC employee or notarized. Answers: on this PDF each of lines 5 to 7 has its box named for the line below it (item 5's box is called '6 ...'), so the map writes by where each box sits. Corporate signers are 'name, title' (names last, first, middle, as the form asks; the title ticks its box). 'Other: text' writes the text. 'None' leaves an optional line blank. Every signature and date signed, the reverse page's additional signers, and the witness or notary blocks are left for the signers.
